title.narrative: PARTNERSHIP FOR NET ZERO INDUSTRY: Sustainable national transformation pathways to climate neutral industry by 2050

description.narrative: The Net Zero Partnership for Industry Decarbonization provides technical assistance to first-mover emerging and developing economies to decarbonize heavy emitting industries. It supports defining shared visions and pathways for decarbonization, creating enabling policies, preparing investment-ready projects, and fostering partnerships and global knowledge sharing. The Climate Club’s Global Matchmaking Platform acts as a single-point gateway for emerging and developing country governments to raise customized requests and identify globally leading technical and financial solutions to decarbonize their energy and emissions intense industrial sectors. The Global Industrial Decarbonization Hub Accelerator establishes dedicated platforms in emerging and developing economies with the objective of mobilizing national and international investments in support of the country’s priorities to accelerate industrial development and decarbonization in heavy industries. Together, these three pillars ensure that industrial decarbonization efforts are not only initiated but sustained over the long term in the countries and replicated in other contexts.
